title: Denver Wedding Andrew and Emily Rotta
author: madwire
excerpt: What a WONDERFUL wedding! DJ’s Andrew and Bryan from JAMMIN’ DJs Denver kept this jumping all night. This has got to be one of the most responsive dancing crowds at a wedding ever!  Congratulations to Emily and Andrew on their new life together! JAMMIN’ DJs wishes you the best!
